basic_details.short_information: Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Tumakuru Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website tumakuru.dcourts.gov.in. A total of 24 vacancies have been announced through the Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026 for Stenographer Grade-III and Typist posts.

application_fee.details: Fee must be paid online only through State Bank Collect (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/QR Code) via the link on the official website. Demand Draft, postal order, money order, or challan payments will not be accepted. E-verification of the payment is mandatory immediately after payment.

age_limit.details: Age will be reckoned as on the last date for submission of application (24 August 2026). The minimum age is 18 years. Maximum age limits by category, including the one-time 5-year relaxation granted vide Government Order dated 29 January 2026, are given below. | Additional age relaxation is available to government employees, widows, ex-servicemen, and persons with disability as per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977.

qualification.details: Stenographer Grade-III: | Passed Second PUC examination, or holds a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice or an equivalent qualification Passed the Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, or an equivalent qualification | Typist: | Passed Second PUC examination, or holds a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice or an equivalent qualification Passed the Senior Grade Kannada and English typewriting examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, or an equivalent qualification | Selection will be made by direct recruitment as per the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Ministerial and Other Posts) (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2021.

selection_process: A dictation of 120 words per minute for 5 minutes each in Kannada and English will be given by an examiner appointed by the recruiting authority; candidates must transcribe it within 45 minutes using a computer with special software Kannada and English skill tests each carry a maximum of 100 marks; a minimum of 50 marks in each is required to qualify Candidates will be shortlisted for interview at a ratio of 1:5 based on the combined percentage of qualifying examination marks and skill test marks The interview carries 5 marks

A dictation of 15 minutes each in Kannada and English will be given; candidates must type it using a computer with special software Kannada and English skill tests each carry a maximum of 100 marks; a minimum of 50 marks in each is required to qualify Candidates will be shortlisted for interview at a ratio of 1:5 based on the combined percentage of qualifying examination marks and skill test marks The interview carries 5 marks
Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of 2 years as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules
during which they must pass the departmental examinations
how_to_apply: Open the online application link for Stenographer Grade-III/Typist recruitment
Upload a scanned signature on white paper in black ballpoint pen (2.5 cm x 7.5 cm, JPG format, up to 25 KB)
Upload a recent passport-size photograph with white background (5 cm x 3.6 cm, JPG format, up to 50 KB); the photograph must not be signed
Fill in all required details in the application form accurately
Pay the applicable fee online via State Bank Collect (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/QR Code) and complete e-verification immediately
Download and print the filled application form and the fee payment receipt
Retain the printed application and receipt safely until the recruitment process is complete, and carry them along with a photo ID to the skill test/interview
important_instructions: Candidates should submit only one application covering all categories/reservations they wish to claim Incomplete applications or those with incorrect information will be rejected Mobile number and email ID are mandatory in the application The list of candidates eligible for the skill test/interview will be published on the official website; no separate individual call letters will be issued by post The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment Candidates must not contact the office by telephone or letter regarding the recruitment Furnishing false information, impersonation, or adopting unfair means at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature besides criminal and disciplinary action The number and category-wise distribution of posts are subject to change without prior notice This recruitment is subject to the final orders of the Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka in the matter referenced in Government Order No. CiAsuE 01 SeVam 2026 dated 27 February 2026

content_sections.heading: Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026: Direct Notification PDF & Apply Online Link
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Tumakuru has released the Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026 Notification (Notification No. ADM-I-144/2026) for 24 vacancies of Stenographer Grade-III and Typist posts. Eligible candidates can apply online from 25 July 2026 to 24 August 2026 (11:59 PM) through the official website. Candidates can use the direct links below to download the official notification PDF, check the vacancy details, eligibility, selection process, application fee, and submit their online application. Click Here to Download Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Click Here to Apply Online for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
Tumakuru District Court Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers 24 vacancies across two posts. The category-wise breakup (including backlog posts) is given below.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Age will be reckoned as on the last date for submission of application (24 August 2026). The minimum age is 18 years. Maximum age limits by category, including the one-time 5-year relaxation granted vide Government Order dated 29 January 2026, are given below. Additional age relaxation is available to government employees, widows, ex-servicemen, and persons with disability as per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Stenographer Grade-III: Passed Second PUC examination, or holds a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice or an equivalent qualification Passed the Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, or an equivalent qualification Typist: Passed Second PUC examination, or holds a 3-year Diploma in Commercial Practice or an equivalent qualification Passed the Senior Grade Kannada and English typewriting examinations conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, or an equivalent qualification Selection will be made by direct recruitment as per the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Ministerial and Other Posts) (Recruitment) (Amendment) Rules, 2021.

content_sections.heading: Tumakuru District Court Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Stenographer Grade-III: A dictation of 120 words per minute for 5 minutes each in Kannada and English will be given by an examiner appointed by the recruiting authority; candidates must transcribe it within 45 minutes using a computer with special software Kannada and English skill tests each carry a maximum of 100 marks; a minimum of 50 marks in each is required to qualify Candidates will be shortlisted for interview at a ratio of 1:5 based on the combined percentage of qualifying examination marks and skill test marks The interview carries 5 marks Typist: A dictation of 15 minutes each in Kannada and English will be given; candidates must type it using a computer with special software Kannada and English skill tests each carry a maximum of 100 marks; a minimum of 50 marks in each is required to qualify Candidates will be shortlisted for interview at a ratio of 1:5 based on the combined percentage of qualifying examination marks and skill test marks The interview carries 5 marks Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of 2 years as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977, during which they must pass the departmental examinations, Kannada language examination, and computer literacy examination.

content_sections.heading: Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee must be paid online only through State Bank Collect (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/QR Code) via the link on the official website. Demand Draft, postal order, money order, or challan payments will not be accepted. E-verification of the payment is mandatory immediately after payment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 24 August 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 vacancies in total - 10 for Stenographer Grade-III and 14 for Typist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Tumakuru District Court Stenographer Grade-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Second PUC or hold an equivalent qualification, along with a Senior Grade Kannada and English shorthand certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, 2A, 2B, 3A, and 3B category candidates must pay Rs. 200/-. SC, ST, Category-1, and PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age for general category candidates is 35 years, plus a one-time 5-year relaxation, making it 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a skill test (Kannada and English dictation/typing) followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Tumakuru District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only through https://tumakuru.dcourts.gov.in/; postal or hand-delivered applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for Stenographer Grade-III and Typist posts?
faq.answer: Stenographer Grade-III carries a pay scale of Rs. 44,425 to Rs. 83,700, and Typist carries a pay scale of Rs. 34,100 to Rs. 67,600.
